caption: The drawing shows a textile pattern composed of a blue background with white floral designs. The composition features a large central circular motif that includes symmetrical arrangements of flowers and leaves, all outlined in white. Surrounding this central motif, there are rectangular and square border sections adorned with smaller floral patterns, also in white on blue. The left edge of the design displays a fringe, rendered with white lines, indicating the edge of the fabric. The overall arrangement is geometric, with straight borders dividing the main circular motif from the side patterns. The floral motifs are repeated across the sections, creating a cohesive and unified design in blue and white tones.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
